        fetch-depth: 1
    - name: Cache Gradle dependencies

      with:
        path: ~/.gradle/caches
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-${{ hashFiles('**/*.gradle*', '**/gradle-wrapper.properties') }}
    - name: Build
      uses: ./.github/actions/run-gradle
    - name: Archive Open Test Reports
      uses: ./.github/actions/archive-reports
      if: ${{ always() }}

  Windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
    - name: Check out repository
      uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      with:
        fetch-depth: 1
    - name: Cache Gradle dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.gradle/caches
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-${{ hashFiles('**/*.gradle*', '**/gradle-wrapper.properties') }}
    - name: Build
      uses: ./.github/actions/run-gradle
    - name: Archive Open Test Reports
      uses: ./.github/actions/archive-reports
      if: ${{ always() }}

  macOS:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
    - name: Check out repository
      uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      with:
        fetch-depth: 1
    - name: Cache Gradle dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.gradle/caches
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-${{ hashFiles('**/*.gradle*', '**/gradle-wrapper.properties') }}
    - name: Build
      uses: ./.github/actions/run-gradle
    - name: Archive Open Test Reports
      uses: ./.github/actions/archive-reports
      if: ${{ always() }}

  FreeBSD:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      GRADLE_USER_HOME: ./.gradle-user-home
    steps:
    - name: Check out repository
      uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      with:
        fetch-depth: 1
    - name: Set up Gradle
      uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@8da46b539cd8fe6ab27ca75128919a18d757604c # v6.4.1
    - name: Cache Gradle dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: .gradle-user-home
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-${{ hashFiles('**/*.gradle*', '**/gradle-wrapper.properties') }}
    - name: Run tests in FreeBSD VM
      uses: vmactions/freebsd-vm@c46abacb49f09938ca4e1702d15d836285d694cc # v1.5.9
      with:
        release: "15.0"
        arch: x86_64
        sync: rsync
        copyback: true
        usesh: true
        envs: 'DEVELOCITY_ACCESS_KEY GRADLE_USER_HOME'
        prepare: |
          pkg install -y bash curl git openjdk25 node24 npm-node24
          mount -t procfs proc /proc
        run: |
          pwd
          freebsd-version
          npm i -g corepack --force
          corepack enable npm
          ./gradlew \
          -DRUNNER_TEMP="$(pwd)/.gradle-actions-runner-temp" \
          -Dorg.gradle.java.installations.auto-download=false \
          -Dorg.gradle.java.installations.paths=/usr/local/openjdk25 \
          -PopenTestReporting.nodeDownload=false \
          --refresh-dependencies \
          javaToolchains \
          build
    - name: Copy captured build results for setup-gradle
      if: ${{ always() }}
      run: |
        if [ -d ./.gradle-actions-runner-temp/.gradle-actions ]; then
          cp -r ./.gradle-actions-runner-temp/.gradle-actions "$RUNNER_TEMP/"
        fi
    - name: Archive Open Test Reports
      uses: ./.github/actions/archive-reports
      if: ${{ always() }}",

Evidence from P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (experiment batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200) shows adding actions/cache for ~/.gradle/caches after Gradle setup and before the build reduced median elapsed time by about 20% while preserving all build/test steps. The pattern preconditions are met: repeated dependency fetching occurs across jobs, and cache inputs include the lockfile/gradle-wrapper properties. No existing cache step is present. The change adds only the standard actions/cache@v4 action (GitHub's own cache service, no external network beyond Gradle's existing dependency downloads, no privileged actions, secrets, or deployment operations), preserves every build/test/archive step and required check, and is placed before the build step in each job.   "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
